tasks.answer: Use DeleteDiscussion, the destructive confirmation control for deleting a discussion; pass the discussion id as the required id prop.

LoginForm uses the shared Input (ui.form.Input). It binds react-hook-form via the required registration prop of type Partial<UseFormRegisterReturn>, e.g. registration={register('email')}, inside the Form wrapper that provides the react-hook-form context.
Table pagination is TablePagination from @/components/ui/table/pagination; it requires totalPages, currentPage and rootUrl (hrefs are built from the root URL plus page).
MDPreview renders Markdown as sanitized HTML with prose typography; the Markdown body is passed via its required value prop.
CreateDiscussion is the admin-only drawer form that creates a discussion with title and Markdown body; it requires the Authorization provider and only admins see the trigger (no props required).
